name: ImageArg
description: The growing interest in developing corpora of persuasive texts has promoted applications in automated systems, e.g., debating and essay scoring systems; however, there is little prior work mining image persuasiveness from an argumentative perspective. To expand persuasiveness mining into a multi-modal realm, we present a multi-modal dataset, ImageArg, consisting of annotations of image persuasiveness in tweets. The annotations are based on a persuasion taxonomy we developed to explore image functionalities and the means of persuasion. We benchmark image persuasiveness tasks on ImageArg using widely-used multi-modal learning methods. The experimental results show that our dataset offers a useful resource for this rich and challenging topic, and there is ample room for modeling improvement.
reputation: A niche multimodal dataset used in research on image persuasiveness, but it has not become a widely adopted standard benchmark.
notes: Relatively small, domain-specific dataset; performance is typically reported with standard multimodal classifiers rather than LLM-style benchmarks.
